newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-WHISTLER DOWNHILL MOVED TO VAL GARDENA.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WHISTLER DOWNHILL MOVED TO VAL GARDENA.

text.p: The men's World Cup downhill cancelled at Whistler, British Columbia on Saturday because of too much snow was rescheduled on Monday for December 20 in Val Gardena, Italy by the International Ski Federation.
The race will be the first of back-to-back downhills at the Italian resort, joining the already scheduled race set for December 21.
Bad weather plagued the B.C. resort on Canada's west coast all last week, wiping out training and forcing the cancellation of the first men's downhill of the season and Sunday's super giant slalom.
A new date and site for the super giant slalom has not yet been decided.
